versions.subject: Rule Update
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\outllib.dll'
filter:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\OFFICE'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\OFFICE'
        - 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\Root\OFFICE'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\Root\OFFICE'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\outllib.dll" NOT (ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\OFFICE*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\OFFICE*", "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\Root\\OFFICE*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\Root\\OFFICE*"))
